hub.detail.access.official_required: Request access on the official site

hub.storage.bar.none: No model folders are registered yet.
hub.storage.bar.offline: The drive or folder is not available; its registration is kept.
hub.storage.bar.pending: Still to be written by downloads
hub.storage.bar.title: Storage capacity
hub.storage.bar.unavailable: The capacity could not be read right now.
hub.storage.cache.title: Hugging Face cache drive
hub.storage.folder.addressHint: Type a folder path, or leave it empty to list the drives

hub.storage.migration.rollbackTitle: Switch back to the old path

hub.storage.migrations.none: No moves yet. Preview one to start.
hub.storage.migrations.title: Moves

hub.storage.planner.nameHint: Leave empty to keep the source folder name
hub.storage.planner.previewNote: The preview checks the target and the free space and creates nothing.

hub.storage.preview.title: Move preview
